tiny.menu.set replaces the whole menu bar: to add one menu, send them all again.
app.paths.data, cache and logs are not created for you. mkdir before you write there.
Every window's page talks to the same backend, so windows share state through it.
tiny.store is for small settings; reach for SQLite (tjs:sqlite) once you need queries.
readAccess widens what file:// pages may load; it does not give the page the filesystem.
{ role: 'help' } on macOS gets the system search field at the top of the Help menu for free.
Files in resources/ ship with the app; app.paths.resources finds them in dev and in builds.
Bump version when you edit a help book: Help Viewer caches books by version.
